caption: The drawing depicts a four-wheeled cart with a rectangular body, colored primarily in shades of brown and reddish-brown, and constructed out of what appears to be wood and metal. The cart has thin, metallic, spoked wheels and prominent axles. Extending horizontally above the cart are two long, dark-colored rods with cylindrical ends, supported and connected by curved metal arms attached to either side of the cart. A large, funnel-shaped fixture in a copper-brown tone is mounted vertically at the front left of the cart, while a cylindrical component is situated centrally. The main body of the cart, as well as the frame holding the rods, features details painted in a reddish-brown hue. Several bolts, brackets, and mechanical details are visible on the apparatus. The surface beneath the cart is a plain, light beige background without any discernible scenery or additional objects.
title: Hand Operated Fire Pump
